notes: New 🗓 Weekly tab in the portfolio: a week-by-week diary of how you actually went. Two honest columns — Closed (realised profit after fees on trades that finished that week) and Open moved (what your still-held shares did, real but only on paper until you sell) — because either one alone tells half the story. Weeks run Monday to Friday, every week since you started is there, and you can write yourself a note on any of them. Weeks with fewer than five closed trades say so plainly: too small a sample to read as skill either way.
